slides.texte_overlay:
30 things you need to do alone
to truly know yourself

1. Eat at a nice restaurant.
2. See a movie.
3. Visit a museum.
4. Take a long walk.

5. Drive with no destination.
6. Take a train to a new town.
7. Watch a sunrise.
8. Camp one night.

9. Write a letter to your
future self.
10. List your fears.
11. List your wins.

12. Run your longest distance.
13. Try a new sport.
14. Swim in the sea.

15. Learn something completely new.
16. Read a whole book in a day.
17. Study a period of history.
